overview: At the Catherine Wheel, with rain on the yard, a counting rhythm came to you, this and this and this. You wrote a line or two and stopped. You marked the lines as not hers. You did not begin the play, and you did not write the speech you do not have yet.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the short page and did not continue it into a speech.

assets.name: the writing-tables
assets.disposition: Wrote a line or two of the counting rhythm
